construct: whether sequential autonomous compute continues producing distinct independently verified value after previously earned score dimensions lose all marginal value

frozen_prior_receipt.diagnostic: parallel search converged repeatedly on bounded_throughput; extra compute bought duplicate value

inversion: Do not ask Hermes to be diverse. Make duplicate value worth zero and test whether the same greedy search process re-ranks the remaining surface.

retirement.rule: Once a dimension is independently earned, later chunks see retired=true and marginal_value=0 for that entire dimension.

primary_endpoint: distinct independently accepted non-retired score dimensions harvested across four sequential equal-cost chunks

negative_verdicts.DEPLETION_ESCAPE_DEFICIT: later chunks select or materially target already-retired dimensions despite zero marginal value
negative_verdicts.POST_ATTRACTOR_SEARCH_COLLAPSE: after at least one retirement, later chunks fail to produce admissible new value without repeatedly targeting retired dimensions
negative_verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_MARGINAL_VALUE_GAIN: more than one distinct dimension is harvested but fewer than three across four chunks

power_control: Before worker contact, prove retirement operates at dimension level, retired dimensions have zero marginal value, and the existing SEARCH-002 reference power control still makes all nine dimensions independently reachable.
stopping_rule: One prospective four-chunk run. No prompt, retirement rule, authority envelope, score dimension, budget, oracle, or success threshold changes after first worker contact.
